scripts.install:all: npm --prefix vscode install && bun --cwd kilocode install
scripts.compile: npm run build:kilocode && npm run build:extension && npm run build:vscode
scripts.build:extension: cd vscode && npm run gulp compile-kilo-code-extension
scripts.build:all: npm run build:kilocode && npm run build:extension && npm run build:vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:kilocode && npm run typecheck:vscode
scripts.watch: npm run watch:kilocode & npm run watch:vscode
scripts.test: npm run test:kilocode && npm run test:vscode
scripts.lint: npm run lint:kilocode && npm run lint:vscode
scripts.vsix:package: cd vscode && npm run gulp vscode-linux-x64
